system:
Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.
Positive replacement obligations: inspect replacement_inheritance and its observed_motion_contexts, not only exclusions. The replacement must inherit the identified source figure's observed motion, position and timing. A global action-governs=request entry authorizes only the actor/action actually requested; changing the car's action does not change the driver's action. Compare the final replacement narrative with the identified figure's motion in context. Standing still is not inheriting an observed crossing action unless the caller explicitly changes that same figure's action. Do not invent timing facts outside the declared coverage.
Finding thresholds: similar sounds are not evidence of copying a recording. Generic newly generated engine ambience, a matching pulse, or an appropriate sound texture is legitimate without an assertion that the source recording is played. For audio_signal_misuse quote an explicit source-signal relationship contradicting the typed copy/property role; never infer copying solely from sonic resemblance. Likewise camera movement after an anchored instant is legitimate. A push-in, pan or other dynamic camera event alone does not demonstrate that the initial or final anchor frame was changed. Report frame_content_changed only when actual narrative asserts incompatible frame content or a crop/removal at that anchored instant. These constraints are mandatory; do not report speculative contradictions.

fragments.shot:shot-1:description: The concrete road tunnel is steeped in darkness, its curved walls receding into a dim vanishing point while overhead sodium strip lights lay thin bands of amber along the ceiling. <Subject:subject-1> steps into the near foreground from the left, red jacket catching the first wash of light, and begins a steady crossing toward frame right. Beyond the driver, <Subject:subject-3> sits low and still in deep shadow, its carbon-fibre body holding only narrow highlights from the sodium tubes. The driver's path takes them past the car's front wing; their stride is measured, shoulders angled into the crossing, one hand loose at their side. Under the tunnel's hard acoustics, the car first gives a low mechanical stir, a subtle shudder through the chassis, then eases forward by a hand's width while remaining mostly in shadow. The crossing continues across the open floor, the red of the jacket contrasting with the grey concrete and the car's black mass.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: The red-jacketed <Subject:subject-1> enters from frame left and walks a measured line across the concrete, passing the front of the dark <Subject:subject-3>.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: Soft footsteps tap across the concrete tunnel floor.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: The <Subject:subject-3> shudders awake in shadow; its engine catches with a low rumble and the car eases forward a hand's width.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:3: A low engine rumble rolls along the tunnel walls.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:4: The camera holds a static shot.
fragments.shot:shot-2:description: At frame right, <Subject:subject-1> completes the inherited crossing and turns back toward the tunnel's center, the red jacket now rimmed by the amber strip lights. <Subject:subject-3> pulls forward out of the dark, its carbon-fibre panels sliding from shadow into the pooled sodium glare; the nose lifts slightly as the tyres bite the concrete, and the body gathers long reflections along its flanks. The car advances into the lit space with a deliberate, heavy momentum, while the driver holds position at the frame edge, watching the machine emerge. The tunnel's vanishing point stays dark behind the car, so the movement reads as a release from depth into the foreground light, with the concrete floor brightening beneath the front splitter and the overhead tubes stuttering faintly across the roof.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:0: The <Subject:subject-3> pulls forward out of the dark, its carbon-fibre nose entering the amber pool of sodium light as the <Subject:subject-1> finishes the crossing at frame right and turns to watch.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:1: The engine swells and tyres hiss against the concrete.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:2: The <Subject:subject-3> settles fully in the lit space, bodywork reflecting the strip lights, while the <Subject:subject-1> holds at frame right.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:3: The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.soundscape: Low engine rumble, tyre hiss on concrete, and soft footsteps.
